newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, compared to Monday's close, USDA said. Trade was moderate, with demand and seller interest also moderate. Offerings were current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs few 69.50-70.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 69.50-70.50 ld 71.00.

Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Monday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 112.00-113.00. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 103.00-105.00 couple lds 106.00-106.50 Holsteins-(grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 108.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 103.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 112.00-113.00.
